name: Roxy Six Shots
source:
Roxy Six Shots is a lethal mutant with superhuman reflexes and a deadly ability to handle her two guns, customized to fire explosive or sedative bullets. A former secret agent, she became a ruthless mercenary after discovering she had been betrayed by her superiors, and now lives for chaos and revenge. Roxy doesn't kill out of necessity, but for pure, cold, calculated satisfaction.
